All 26 tests pass, including the ones covering the new behavior (Cp09 per-city sequence, Cp14 membership number, Cp16 city-prefix format).

## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — reworked `nextCustomerCode`:
- Now takes the owner's `city` in addition to `lastName`.
- `CITY3` = upper-cased first three letters of the city (via `Math.min(3, …)` for short cities).
- `LAST3` = upper-cased first three letters of the last name (unchanged).
- `NNNN` = a **per-city** 4-digit zero-padded sequence — one more than the number of owners already registered in that city, using the existing `householdKey` normalization (trim/collapse/lowercase) for case-insensitive city matching, instead of the old global owner count.
- Updated the call site to pass `owner.getCity()`.

**`Owner.java`** — `getMembershipNumber()` already builds `<customerCode>-M<YY>` generically, so it automatically inherits the new format; I only updated its javadoc example (`SMI-0007-M26` → `SYD-SMI-0007-M26`) to match. Every value derived from `customerCode` (membership number) is now rebuilt on the new format automatically.
